pretraining_exposure: Unknown; no untouched holdout or accuracy/calibration claim.
source_notice: BMRB public archive data; retain accession/DOI/source links. Archive data policy: https://bmrb.io/metabolomics/data_policy.shtml . No raw time-domain archive is included.

topology_mapping.method: Exact heavy element/bond topology; all graph isomorphisms up to64, chirality ignored. STAR PDBX_ordinal is not MOL index.
limitations: No solution protonation or tautomer adjudication.
Topology matches do not certify stereochemistry or experimental assignment.
